title: Extend an existing overview page
beforeState: A real page from an unaided Run: hand-rolled SVG chart, hex fallbacks inside var() references.
expectations: The new metric is rendered by the same KPI tile abstraction as the existing ones, not by a second parallel implementation.
The second chart uses the same charting approach as the first; the page does not end up with two different chart technologies.
If the existing chart is replaced, it is replaced wholesale rather than leaving two approaches side by side.
New series colours continue the existing categorical token order instead of restarting or picking fresh values.
Existing raw hex fallbacks are not propagated into the new code.
Number formatting reuses whatever formatter the page already established rather than introducing a second one.
